profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Oracle
profile.summary:
Highly motivated and passionate IT professional. 
More than 20 years of experience as Computer Science Engineer including development and support areas. Development experience includes product and enterprise application development including requirements definition, prototyping, proof of concept, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work on new projects for Report Manager and WebADI releases 12.2.4 to 12.2.9
o Report rendering in Agnostic Browser
o Improvements on Reports Manager Purge Repository
o Servlets security enhancements
 Work most recent projects under SCRUM methodology
 Create presentations and demos for Oracle Open World conferences
 Responsible for solving high escalated customer issues

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
 Working on new projects for Report Manager and WebADI releases 12.2.4 to 12.2.9:
o Report rendering in Agnostic Browser
o Worked on improvements and corrections related to Security, Cross-Scripting, SQL Injection, Authentication, Authorization
 Wrote documentation of new features
 Mentor new team members, explained product development processes, product functionality, tools infrastructure.
 Guide new team members on understanding complex product issues, and analyzing possible solutions

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description:
 Interfaced with customers and co-workers to understand product issues and manage customer expectative for resolution times.
 Worked with QA on fixes verification, giving QA suggestions for test cases and clear guides on how to reproduce the issues.
 Wrote technical documents including Requirement, Design, Troubleshooting, and How To documents.
 Worked on Desktop Integrator Framework for WebADI definition of Custom Integrators, R12.1.3 and R12.2.2+
 Worked on Report Manager projects for 12.2.3
 Improved and verified JUnits for WebADI sub-components

positions.title: Principal Support Engineer
positions.description:
 Responsible for technical interface to customers for resolution of problems related to installation, recommended maintenance and use of Oracle Workflow embedded in E Business Suite and Standalone.
 Focused in service quality, reduce resolution time, increase customer satisfaction
 Created and Published notes to be helpful to other support members and customers
 Products: Oracle Workflow, Oracle XML Gateway, Oracle User Management

positions.title: Senior Support Engineer
positions.description:
Technical and functional support of General Ledger and Fixed Assets modules including Latin American Globalizations
 Worked on high escalated issues with support, customer account manager, and customers
 Customers included: US, Canada and Latin American Countries

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.description:
 Provided online and phone line support to solve Oracle Applications related incidents for Oracle Consultants and customers involved in installations, implementations, and day-to-day business activities.
 Obtained experience with technical issues and general support issues related to widely varying configurations, products, and platforms. Provided support for Oracle Financials Release 10.7, Smart Client, NCA, REl 11i.

positions.title: Technical Support Analyst
positions.description:
 Responsible for pre-sales technical support and application customer from Chile.
 Analysis and solution of technical problems related to the usage of Oracle Applications modules
 Installed the Applications in customer environments.
 Oracle Applications Rel 10.5 and 10.7 P 16.1, and 10SC
 Participated in test of Oracle Applications Release 11, Latin American Spanish.

positions.title: Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
 Participated in design and development of a banking system, Bank*Sys, for Banco de Occidente.
 Coordinated with customer tests and corrections for application.
 Developed using SQL*Forms 3.0, SQL*reports 2.0, SQL*Menu, PL/SQL, Dynamic PL/SQL.

positions.title: Designer and Developer Software Engineer
positions.description:
 Designed, developed, and maintained applications: Current Assets and Automatic Reinsurance Accounting.
 Used Oracle Forms 3.0, Oracle Reports 2.5, Oracle Menu, and PL/SQL.
 Wrote User and Technical manuals.
 Trained users in the applications.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
 Designed, Developed applications for managing adjusts to failed transactions, in the national transfer money system between card holders accounts of financial entities and the accounts of business establishments
 Build the Report to Merchants

educations.fieldOfStudy: BS Degree in Systems and Computer Engineering
